sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ददौ तेभ्यो भूषणानि यथार्हतः ।वज्राणि च महार्हाणि सस्वजे च नरर्षभः ।। ७.३९.२५ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā dadau tebhyo bhūṣaṇāni yathārhataḥ ।vajrāṇi ca mahārhāṇi sasvaje ca nararṣabhaḥ ।। 7.39.25 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, Rama, the best among men, gave them ornaments and very valuable diamonds as was fitting, and also embraced them.
